feed.subtitle: Follow NPR National News for reporting across the United States. Explore coverage of economic affordability, immigration, climate, environmental policy, justice and social trends.

entry.title: Manchester United names USMNT coach Mauricio Pochettino as its manager
entry.summary: Mauricio Pochettino is out as head coach of the U.S. men's national soccer team. Pochettino led the U.S. to the round of 16 at last year's World Cup. He's departing to coach Manchester United.

entry.title: Investigation into what cause deadly Brooklyn building collapse continues
entry.summary: Investigators are trying to find out what went wrong after an apartment building collapsed into a nearby construction site in Brooklyn, New York, killing at least eight people.

entry.title: Hegseth awards medal to soldier who chastised him
entry.summary:
Pete Hegseth was yelled at by a sentinel for poor decorum at Arlington National Cemetery. Now the Secretary of Defense has
given him a medal.

entry.title: Rivers in the sky are raining down on the Pacific Northwest. What are they?
entry.summary: Atmospheric rivers are large bands of water vapor in the sky. They are dumping trillions of gallons of water on Washington and Oregon, just as high tides and winds batter shorelines.

entry.title: Why even a fraction of a degree can escalate climate change impacts
entry.summary: Countries are not meeting their goal of limiting climate change to 1.5 degrees Celsius. How much hotter the planet gets makes a profound difference for the impacts the world could see.

entry.title: Who yelled at Pete Hegseth at Arlington National Cemetery? The quiz knows
entry.summary: Plus: Have you been following news about cars and Pete Hegseth this week?

entry.title: These two voter turnout trends explain what happened across the South in the election
entry.summary: In six states across the Deep South, a drastic swing to the left this election was driven by high Black voter turnout and compounded by a sharp decline in voting rates across Republican-heavy areas.

entry.title: 'It was an adventure': Brothers remember growing up in an original Route 66 motel
entry.summary: The Sunset Motel in Moriarty, New Mexico, is the last original Route 66 motel owned and operated by the family that built it.

entry.title: Cindy Holscher wins in Kansas, holding governor's office for Democrats
entry.summary: Holscher, a state senator, overcame a more well-known Republican who had Trump's endorsement in the state that has gone to the GOP in most other statewide races.
